subject: health
unitTitle: Consumer Health, Coverage Literacy, and Care Navigation
essentialQuestion: How do I get the care I need without being taken advantage of?

prompts.prompt: Explain choosing and establishing with a primary care provider in your own words and give a valid example.
Use a cited source, diagram, model, or documented process to show understanding of coverage options after high school and what each actually covers.
Apply reading a bill, an explanation of benefits, and a denial in a new fictional situation. Show the decision process or cite the evidence used.
Analyze a plausible error, weak claim, or unsafe choice involving appealing a denial and asking for an itemized correction; correct it and explain why.
Connect prescription cost, generics, and assistance programs with recognizing predatory health marketing aimed at young adults. Explain how the two support, constrain, or build on one another.
Present the strongest evidence from the unit task: Work three fictional cases: establish care, decode a bill and an explanation of benefits, and draft an appeal letter for a denied claim.
Identify one skill you can now transfer, one check that improves accuracy, and one next question.

adaptationChoices: Cases may be worked in writing, on annotated printouts, verbally with an adult, or on a supplied guided frame with terms pre-defined.
accommodationNote: Access supports may change format, pacing, quantity, setting, or response mode without changing the standard being assessed. No assessment requires disclosure, a recording, or any body measurement.
trustedAdultNote: Direct any urgent safety, health, or mental-health concern to a trusted adult or qualified professional; this course is not diagnosis, therapy, or treatment.
neverRequires: This task never requires body weight, height, BMI, or body-fat percentage.
This task never requires calorie counting or a diet or weight-loss goal.
This task never requires disclosing private medical history, a diagnosis, or sexual history.
This task never requires a photograph, video, or voice recording of the learner as proof.
This task never requires a public performance or an audience.
